data.subject: Request for Deadline Extension
data.body:
Dear Arhaam,

I hope you are doing well.

I am writing to respectfully request a brief extension for the upcoming
deadline of the assigned task. Due to unforeseen circumstances, I require a
little additional time to ensure the work is completed to the highest
standard of quality.

I kindly request an extension of a few days and assure you that I remain
fully committed to completing the task promptly and efficiently. Please let
me know if this request can be accommodated.

Thank you for your understanding and consideration.

Sincerely,
Hunain
